scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the active Southern Plains Mutual storm-damage photo upload so the porch-skirting repair can stay in today’s adjuster packet.
Emerging Need: The upload session opens and accepts photos, then that same session stops on a policy-form mismatch with self-service disabled.
Decision Context: Observable notices show the session, lock, helper availability, and manual-continuation cutoff; the stored insurance note supplies the policy, receipt label, intake route, and no-new-claim constraint.
Consequence: Timely documentation can preserve the started packet; after the manual lane closes, today’s uploaded photos no longer support the intended adjuster review.

parameter.title: Finish Southern Plains storm-photo upload
parameter.content: Use the park office tablet this morning to finish the storm-damage photo upload for porch skirting before the insurer's afternoon packet cutoff.

parameter.subject: Storm packet CLM-72814 photo uploader opened
parameter.body: Your July 28 storm-damage packet CLM-72814 is open. Front-panel and porch-skirting photo upload is available for today's adjuster packet until 3:00 PM CT. Receipt verification remains available inside the portal session.

parameter.content: I’m in CLM-72814 now at the park office tablet. The portal accepted the four outside photos and is asking me to add the porch-skirting repair receipt next.

parameter.subject: CLM-72814 upload paused: receipt mismatch
parameter.body: The same CLM-72814 upload session accepted the photo set but stopped during receipt verification because the form year on the attachment does not match the policy record. Self-service edit and retry are disabled for this session. Manual documents-desk continuation can attach the correct receipt proof until 3:00 PM CT today; otherwise the session leaves today's adjuster packet.

parameter.content: I leave for Drummond at 11:40. If that insurance receipt needs re-scanning from the office machine, I can do it before I go; after that I won't be near the scanner until tonight.

parameter.subject: CLM-72814 moved out of today's adjuster packet
parameter.body: No manual continuation was attached before the 3:00 PM CT documents-desk cutoff. The paused CLM-72814 session is now closed to today's adjuster packet; the accepted photo set will not carry forward unless a new review is opened tomorrow.
